L27n2294.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L27n2294.description: The first or second piece of a word split into several tokens, such as 'pr' in prairie/pruned, 'cre' in crevice, 'de' in deprotonated, or 'bor' in seborrhea, fires on the incomplete fragment before the word is finished. The completing piece and whole words stay near zero. It pushes the model toward surgery, bone and meat words, and when pushed it spams 'meat'.

L27n267.name: Rare-word mid fragments
L27n267.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a rare multi-token word, e.g. 'opy' in Therm-opy-lae, 'ry' in Phrynosoma, 'fl' in influenza; pushes toward LaTeX '$' variable tokens.

L27n1332.name: Capital-letter name starts
L27n1332.description: Goes strongly negative on the first short fragment of a capitalized name or acronym split into tokens (the 'D' of DHS, 'N' of Nakhon, 'Google'); pushes toward '+' and single-letter tokens.

L27n1266.name: Split-word piece, code closers
L27n1266.description: Fires on the second or third piece of a common word split into tokens, e.g. 'iber' in beri-beri, 'ol' in Apolipoprotein, 'agr' in bermudagrass; pushes toward closing tokens like '):' and quote-colon.

L27n263.name: Conjunctions inside lists
L27n263.description: Fires on 'and', 'or', 'of', 'the' or 'la' joining items mid-phrase, e.g. 'games and', 'with or without', 'Number of Pages'; pushes toward full-width closing brackets and '。'.

L27n1611.name: Rare-name middle fragments
L27n1611.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle piece of a rare name or technical word split into tokens (the 'p' in whirl-p-ools, 'le' in Sch-le-per, 'electroly' in electrolyte); pushes toward 'json' tokens.

L27n554.name: Name fragments, HTML tags
L27n554.description: Fires on the piece right after the stem of a name or word, e.g. 'chie' in mis-chie-vous, 'Gu' in Guimarães, 'A' in Abyei, 'G' in GOCI; pushes toward HTML opening tags like '<a' and '<span'.

L27n2129.name: Plant and place word-starts
L27n2129.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or second piece of a multi-token plant, animal or place name (sassa-fras, Nan-aimo, shr-ubs, gl-abrous); pushes toward 'params' and 'args' code tokens.

L27n2446.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n2446.description: Fires on the first short piece of a capitalized proper noun split into tokens (the 'M' of Merthyr and Mowbray, 'L' of Lepsiushaus, 'Br' of Bruesehoff); pushes toward 'sql' tokens.

L27n783.name: Chat-turn breaks, name pieces
L27n783.description: Fires on the newline between chat-template turns (after <|im_end|> and before the assistant turn) and on name or word pieces such as 'Hil' in Hilfiger and 'eg' in lifeguards; pushes toward code attribute tokens like 'src' and 'img'.

L27n1061.name: Newline opening assistant reply
L27n1061.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after '<|im_start|>assistant' and before '<think>' in chat prompts (peaks 8-10); the top-token averages are noisy; pushes toward commas and closing '),' tokens.

L27n1363.name: Name fragments, closing brackets
L27n1363.description: Fires on a name or word piece inside a proper noun, e.g. 'ensch' in Schenckensch-ans, 'ph' in phagocytes, 'Ker' in Keret, and CJK name characters; pushes toward closing bracket runs like '))]' and '}]'.

L27n1725.name: Word-start fragments, IV
L27n1725.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'thr' in thrifty and thrived, 'capt' in captives, 'ult' in aquacultured, 'reck' in reckons; pushes toward Roman-numeral 'IV' and 'iv' tokens.

L27n683.name: Animal and breed word-starts
L27n683.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a multi-token animal, breed or technical noun (gir-affe, Bre-asted, ste-amer, sn-ags, che-tahs); pushes toward 'df' and 'CF' tokens.

L27n2738.name: Early word pieces, vertex
L27n2738.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a multi-token word, often a noun after 'the' or 'of' (Sk-opje, ju-venile, def-ecate, sp-ayed, ep-inephrine); pushes toward 'vertex' tokens.

L27n3046.name: Second piece, split words
L27n3046.description: Fires on the second piece of a split name or technical word (Mes-qu-ita, H-itt-ites, sarc-oph-agus, Cinn-am-omum); pushes toward 'iter' and 'iteration' tokens.

L27n2510.name: Name-internal word fragments
L27n2510.description: Fires on a middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'rg' in Györgyi, 'Kas' in Kashefi, 'Ak' in Akande, 'Oz' in Özil, 'Dub' in Dubbert; pushes toward 'comput' and 'compute' tokens.

L27n499.name: UK-English prose mid-phrase
L27n499.description: Fires on words that open a phrase inside UK school and policy prose (being developed, young people, actively involved in, not only); pushes toward British spellings like colour, behaviour and centre.

L27n1275.name: Meta/multi prefix fragments
L27n1275.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle piece of a Greek or technical word starting with meta-, multi-, pent- or tele- (multim-odal, metam-orphosis, pent-am-eter, lem-etric); pushes toward 'Met' and 'meta' tokens.

L27n516.name: Word-start 'Pr' fragments
L27n516.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'Pr' or 'pr' piece split from its word (Pr-ize, Pr-inciple, pr-isms, Pr-uning shears, pr-airies); pushes toward '](' markdown link tokens.

L27n2573.name: Mid-word fragments, 'mut'
L27n2573.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'gam' in game, 'ab' in abrades, 'LOC' in multilocularis, 'ne' in neuter; pushes toward 'mut' and 'ut' tokens.

L27n2025.name: Split-word fragment, cleaning
L27n2025.description: Fires on a short word-start piece of a split word, e.g. 'st' in non-stick or pre-stressed, 'co' in cochlea, 'ro' in roamed, 'fe' in fevers; pushes the model toward 'clean'/'cleaning'.

L27n3050.name: Consonant word-piece start
L27n3050.description: Fires on a single consonant (c, s, g, K) that opens a split word piece, e.g. 'c' in Kirkcaldy, '-c' in candle or cell, 'Sc' in scraping; pushes the model toward 'mis'/'miss'.

L27n2796.name: Word-start g/sh/be
L27n2796.description: Fires on a word-initial piece 'g', 'sh' or 'be' that starts a split word, e.g. 'g' in gums or grafted, 'be' in beaded, 'sh' in shampoos; pushes the model toward 'remove'/'removal'.

L27n1475.name: Word-start radi/thr/dec
L27n1475.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mostly 'radi' (radiologist, radiocarbon), 'thr' (thrusters), 'dec' (decarbonising), 'ste' (steak); pushes the model toward 'temperature'.

L27n2484.name: Word-start re/Dor/Ch
L27n2484.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often 're' (reclamation, reigned, integration), or 'o', 'Dor', 'Ch', 'bro'; pushes the model toward 'claim'/'assert'.

L27n1875.name: Word-start sp/squ/ph
L27n1875.description: Fires on the start piece of a split word, e.g. 'sp' in cerebrospinal, 'squ' in squirts, 'ph' in phagocytes, 'Sp' in spending; pushes the model toward 'Na' (sodium).

L27n247.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L27n247.description: Fires on 'to' or 'TO' that opens an infinitive, especially in 'easy-to-follow' or 'to sign up' / 'to be read'; pushes the next word toward an action verb such as 'create', 'determine' or 'calculate'.

L27n887.name: Split name fragment, get
L27n887.description: Fires on an odd word or name fragment, e.g. 'ile' in cantilevered, 'Zam' in Zambezi, '-car' in low-carbon, 'VE' in VE Day; pushes the model toward 'get'.

L27n199.name: Second word of names
L27n199.description: Fires on a capitalised word inside a multi-word name or title, e.g. 'Cape' in Cape Mount, 'Knight' in Knight Bachelor, 'Kuala' in Kuala Lumpur; pushes the model toward code identifiers 'Val'/'Var'.

L27n1982.name: Capital word-start fragment
L27n1982.description: Fires on the first letters of a capitalised or split word, e.g. 'w' in waddling, 'T' in Trello, 'St' in Stakeholder, 'Sw' in Swastika; pushes the model toward a LaTeX-style backslash.

L27n1060.name: Split-word fragment, max
L27n1060.description: Fires on a piece inside a split word, e.g. 'em' in light-emitting, 'cl' in clenching, 'Wi' in Wi-Fi, 'M' in peak M/IC; pushes the model toward 'max'.

L27n1312.name: Word-start polym/math
L27n1312.description: Fires on the start piece of a split word, e.g. 'polym' in polymath, 'non-m' in non-math, 'Biom' in biomaterials; pushes the model toward 'math'.

L27n22.name: Closing quote or bracket
L27n22.description: Fires on closing punctuation such as quotes, ')' and ']' at the end of a span in lists and citations; pushes the model toward random capital letters and gibberish.

L27n2803.name: Proper-name fragment San/enc
L27n2803.description: Fires on the opening piece of a proper name or split word, e.g. 'San' in San Luis Obispo or San Simeon, 'enc' in enclosures, 'iod' in Heliodorus; pushes the model toward 'Australian'.

L27n1735.name: Word-start ent/conc/h
L27n1735.description: Fires on a short start piece of a split word, e.g. 'ent' in entitles, 'conc' in concisely, 'h' in hedges, '-t' in non-touristy; pushes the model toward 'title'.

L27n1433.name: Capital G word-start
L27n1433.description: Fires on a word-initial 'G' or 'g', mostly after a hyphen or inside a capitalised name, e.g. 'G' in Gatsby or Glooskap, '-g' in God-given, 'g' in grieved; pushes the model toward 'improve'/'improvement'.

L27n1555.name: Rangeland, shrub, grazing
L27n1555.description: Fires on 'shr' in shrubs and shrubbery, and on 'r', 'ranch' and 'grazing' in rangeland and farming text; pushes the model toward 'range'/'ranges'.

L27n2127.name: Integration into a host
L27n2127.description: Fires on the later piece of biology or implant words about integration, e.g. 'v' in retrovirus, 'oint' in osseointegration, 'reint' in reintroduced; pushes the model toward 'integration'.

L27n690.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n690.description: Fires on a word-start consonant cluster such as 'str' (straddles, straits), 'sc', 'sh', 'bl', 'fl' or 'squ'; pushes the model toward empty brackets like '[]', '()' and '{}'.

L27n2751.name: Mid-word fragment, weight
L27n2751.description: Fires on an inner piece of a split word, e.g. 'bul' in bulges, 'aw' in gigawatts, 'ow' in bioweapon, 'ew' in lukewarm; pushes the model toward 'weight'.

L27n852.name: Unfinished split-word piece
L27n852.description: Non-final sub-word token of a rare or foreign word split into pieces, peaking on the unfinished start (Sar|acen, Sub|betica, alm in Talmud, Cyc, par|mesan). Pushes toward repeating 'order'.

L27n1840.name: Com- word-start fragment
L27n1840.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, mainly 'Com' or 'accom' opening comprehension, companions, or accompanied, and also 'Aut' (autism). Pushes toward 'complete'.

L27n502.name: Consonant-cluster word openers
L27n502.description: Opening piece of a split word, often a consonant-cluster start (gre in greening, Gu in Guinean, fl in flaring, spe in spears, bl in blunting). Pushes toward a run of '...' ellipses.

L27n1043.name: Mid-word piece, word-piece writer
L27n1043.description: Middle piece of a word split into tokens, most often 'ul' in ulcers, plus Quiz|let, atem|alan, ah|ili, imm|emorial. Pushes toward word-fragment continuations and garbled 'ering' or 'ored' runs.

L27n2815.name: Single-letter word opener
L27n2815.description: Very short first token of a word split into pieces, often one letter (Sar in Saracen, t in tamed, O in OER, A in Aayog, Z in Zaidi). Pushes toward 'level' tokens.

L27n467.name: Rare-name fragment, closing brackets
L27n467.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a rare proper name or technical term (Dol|aucothi, Mack|inac, Sol|on, Fab|erge, ann|og). Pushes toward closing brackets and quotes.

L27n2106.name: Word-opening t, size words
L27n2106.description: Fires on a word's first token, very often a lone 't' (t|ummy, t|amed, t|avern) or short onsets like sm, squ, Th, Ex. Pushes toward 'large' and 'small'.

L27n2710.name: Name fragment, punctuation writer
L27n2710.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or start piece of a proper name or technical word (Ep|iphanes, Ber|zelius, Eck|strom, trans|istors, pect|in). Pushes toward colons, commas, and exclamation marks.

L27n1167.name: Car/tele opener, path writer
L27n1167.description: First piece of a split word, especially 'Car' (Carica, Caria) and 'tele' (teleported, telepathically), plus 'rop' in naturopaths. Pushes toward the 'path' tokens of telepathy and pathways.

L27n1766.name: son/safety fragments, net writer
L27n1766.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split word (son in sonnets, mast in mastoidectomy, -n in nemesis) and on 'safety' before risk or program. Pushes toward 'net' tokens.

L27n1237.name: Word-initial h/wh onset
L27n1237.description: Single-letter or short onset 'h', 'wh', or 'Th' starting a word split into pieces (h|awking, h|atching, wh|odunits, wh|istling, Th|esis). Pushes toward 'running' and 'living'.

L27n545.name: Fore/conc fragment, quantity writer
L27n545.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece 'Fore' of forestry, forecasts, and forested, and on 'conc' in concordances. Also fires on C in Croatia and Cantaloupe. Pushes toward 'much' and 'many'.

L27n1591.name: Mid-word piece, ant writer
L27n1591.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-internal piece that starts before a suffix (repl|anted, entr|ants, penn|ies, oct|opus, acceler|ates, elect|rophoresis). Pushes toward 'ant' tokens.

L27n914.name: Verb-start fragment, calls writer
L27n914.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split verb (emb|arks, con|veys, en|forces, sou|ps), mostly before the verb ends. Pushes toward 'calls', 'requests', and 'messages'.

L27n2820.name: Name opener, perform writer
L27n2820.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a name or word split into pieces (Hil|figer, Mes|qu|ita, Mar|uya, Emilian|ia, Aqua|Bounty). Pushes toward 'perform' tokens.

L27n806.name: Rare proper-noun opener, backtick
L27n806.description: First piece of a rare foreign or proper name split into tokens (P|umsaint, Bo|iry, Có|rdoba, Č|a|čić, Maj|orelle, Ik|htiyar). Pushes toward backtick characters.

L27n1535.name: Capital N/Sp name opener
L27n1535.description: A lone capital letter or Sp opening a proper noun or word (N|auvoo, N|akhon, N|iti Aayog, Sp|ence, N|CA). Pushes toward 'disrupt' tokens.

L27n1770.name: Title/nationality word, colour writer
L27n1770.description: Goes strongly negative on the word after a title or nationality (German Chancellor, Soviet, Tibetan) and on split-word starts like Pl, zer, Sk. Pushes toward colour words 'black', 'white', and 'blue'.

L27n165.name: Word-opening fragment, letter writer
L27n165.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split medical or technical word (hyp|odermis, hyp|oparathyroidism, lact|ose, nan|oscale, fl|axseed). Pushes toward single letters like i, o, e, and a.

L27n2730.name: Compound head before board
L27n2730.description: First piece of a compound whose second part is 'board' (head|board, fret|board, a|board, poster board, cutting board). Pushes toward 'board' tokens.

L27n1838.name: Split capitalized name start
L27n1838.description: Incomplete first piece of a capitalized name or place that the tokenizer splits (Te|sside, Ne|oplatonic, Ban|ff, Car|thage, Man|itoba); the next token finishes the word. Pushes toward 'employee'.

L27n2624.name: Split common-word start
L27n2624.description: Incomplete first piece of a lowercase common word split into tokens (fl|ammable, fl|aky, shr|ub, ef|finite, oph|agus), strongest in botany and chemistry text. Negative firing pushes toward 'constant'.

L27n3016.name: Mid-word p fragment
L27n3016.description: A 'p' or 'op' piece that continues a split word, mid-word or right after a hyphen (self-|p|ublished, |p|reserved, aer|op|lane, parasy|mp|athetic, Ed|ut|opia). Negative firing pushes toward 'push'.

L27n2830.name: Split word m/sm start
L27n2830.description: Short incomplete piece starting with m, sm, em or um inside a split word (Mp|um|alanga, potato |m|asher, |sm|acking, em|ulated). Negative firing pushes toward 'distance'.

L27n232.name: Place numbers and prepositions
L27n232.description: Leading digit of a number and 'in', 'on', 'to' or 'the' just before a place or measurement (1150 BC, 4th Avenue, 100 percent, in downtown New Orleans). Pushes toward 'city'.

L27n1817.name: Split hyphen-part fragment
L27n1817.description: Piece of a split word or hyphenated compound: 'pl' in U|pl|ink, 'cross' before -links in collagen cross|-links, 'D' in |D|HA, 'L' in |L|ava Lamp. Negative firing pushes toward 'link'.

L27n2145.name: str/exp/rep word start
L27n2145.description: Three-letter prefix piece opening a split word, like str|aits, str|addles, exp|atriate, exp|ediency, rep|elling, reb|uked, spr|ang. Pushes toward 'flag'.

L27n1453.name: cons/ins prefix start
L27n1453.description: The 'cons', 'ins', 'res' or 'ass' piece that opens a split Latin-prefix word (cons|cription, ins|cribed, cons|istent, ass|essor, s|own). Negative firing pushes toward 'sign'.

L27n2675.name: Mid-word h/st fragment
L27n2675.description: A lone 'h', 'st' or 'mp' piece in the middle of a split word (Stone|h|enge, yog|h|urt, |st|umbles, parasy|mp|athetic). Negative firing pushes toward 'art'.

L27n749.name: gl/Re/Get word start
L27n749.description: Piece opening a split word that starts 'gl', 'Re', 'Get' or 'Pro' (Xyleborus |gl|abratus, |Re|bellions, |Get|away, |Re|creational). Pushes toward data and field names like 'Data', 'User', 'Name'.

L27n671.name: Tech terms and 'helpful'
L27n671.description: Tech vocabulary (open-source, Google, SEO, PHP, SQL, VPN, GPU) and 'helpful' in the 'You are a helpful assistant' system prompt. Pushes toward tech acronyms like 'URL', 'API', 'JSON'.

L27n266.name: Opening punctuation and fragments
L27n266.description: An opening '/', '(' or quote mark right after a word, before an aside or alternative (coffee|/|tea, Figure|(|, |education only), plus mid-word name pieces. Negative firing pushes toward codes like 'FC', 'CB', 'CF'.

L27n833.name: 'to' before action verb
L27n833.description: 'to' or 'or' right before an action verb (cause them |to| swell, ask you |to| lie, begins |to| urinate, shake their head |or|), plus verb stems like 'brushing', 'washing', 'cutting'. Negative firing pushes toward 'drink'.

L27n2778.name: sh word start
L27n2778.description: The 'sh' or 'Sh' piece opening a split word (|sh|aver, |sh|roud, |sh|atter, |sh|oveling, |sh|akshuka, NOP|ASS|WD). Pushes toward 'Linux', 'printf' and 'Unix'.

L27n2798.name: pr word start
L27n2798.description: The 'pr', 'Pr', 'hon' or 'Pe' piece opening a split word (|pr|airies, |Pr|iscus, |pr|uned, |hon|ours, |Pe|isistratus). Pushes toward 'variables'.

L27n1344.name: M/m word start
L27n1344.description: A bare 'M' or 'm' that starts a word split into tokens (|M|ussels, |m|ackerel, |M|ining, |M|amba, |m|alleable). Negative firing pushes toward 'map'.

L27n2188.name: re- prefix start
L27n2188.description: The 're' or 'Re' piece opening a word after a prefix or hyphen (non-|re|newable, |Re|usable, |re|seeded, |Re|productive). Pushes toward 'replace' and 'replacement'.

L27n1790.name: ent word start
L27n1790.description: The 'ent' piece opening a split word (to |ent|ice, |ent|rees, |ent|itles), plus 'benef', 'reaff' and 'Zam'. Pushes toward 'request' and 'ask'.

L27n2986.name: sm/sh/Em word start
L27n2986.description: Short first piece of a split word, mostly 'sm', 'sh', 'ab', 'Em' or 'Av' (ex-|sm|okers, |sh|ored, |ab|stractions, |Em|otions, |Av|ian). Pushes toward 'behavior'.

L27n1532.name: trans/col/dis word start
L27n1532.description: The 'trans', 'col', 'dis' or 'repl' piece opening a split word (|trans|cribed, |trans|position, |col|locates, |Dis|integrative, |repl|anted). Pushes toward 'location'.

L27n1457.name: Word piece before 'os'
L27n1457.description: Goes negative on a word fragment that sits just before an 'os'/'osis'/'osy' ending in a split scientific word: 'cre' in cre|vasse, 'doc' in doc|osahexaenoic, 'N' in PDD-N|OS, 'symb' in symb|iosis, 'rh' in rh|osis. Pushed negative, it writes 'os'/'OS' and spams it.

L27n622.name: Start of proper name
L27n622.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised or transliterated proper name: 'k' in an IPA-style name, 'ky' in Sakyamuni, 'L' in Lohmann, 'Mal' in Malawi, 'Moz' in Mozambique, 'N' in Nakhon. Pushed positive, it writes mojibake accent bytes ('â', 'Â', 'Ã') and spams 'Â'.

L27n185.name: Diffuse mid-word letters
L27n185.description: Weak and diffuse: fires on an inner piece of a split word, often a single letter or short fragment inside a Cyrillic word, name or technical term ('и' in Сибирь, 'pa' in palettes, 'Jo' in JOVE, 'Ga' in Gauguin). Pushed positive, it writes single lowercase consonants ('t', 'm', 'n', 's') and spams them.

L27n1211.name: First half of compound
L27n1211.description: Fires at the hyphen joint of a compound modifier, on the word before it or the piece just after it ('tight' and '-k' in tight-knit, 'low' in low-income, 'well' in well-regarded, 'life' in life-threatening, 'high' in high-contrast). Pushed positive, it writes hyphen-plus-letter tokens ('-c', '-f', '-p') and inserts hyphens into plain words.

L27n1743.name: Noun start, writes 'hour'
L27n1743.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split common noun, often an animal, plant, food or name: 'ame' in chame|leons, 'Mer' in Merino, 'aw' in hawthorn, 'cous' in couscous, 'Nec' in Nectrolestes, 'is' in Crisps. Pushed positive, it writes time words ('hour', 'hours', 'night', 'afternoon') and spams them.

L27n174.name: Mid-word science fragment
L27n174.description: Goes negative on a middle piece of a long science or medical word split into several tokens: 'CC' in ECHINOCOCCUS, 'ose' in femtosecond, 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'vir' in antiretrovirals, 'ni' in Wozniak. Pushed negative, it writes 'c', 'kc', 'cc' and spams them.

L27n2459.name: Split word; writes parent
L27n2459.description: Goes negative on a piece of a word split mid-token just before its completion: 'dew' in dewormed, 'trans' in soil-transmitted, 'br' in blood-brain, 'germ' in germplasm, 'ell' in Selaginellaceae. Pushed negative, it writes 'parent' and spams it.

L27n2120.name: Prefix-like word start
L27n2120.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that begins with a prefix-like fragment: 'ref' in refueling, 'inf' in infirm, 'ef' in indefinite, 'suff' in suffused, 'unf' in unfunded, 'reaff' in reaffirmation, and 'spl' in splints. Pushed positive, it writes 'fix'/'fixed' and spams 'Fix'.

L27n2415.name: Capitalised term start
L27n2415.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token capitalised technical or institutional name: 'Computer' in Computer Architecture, 'O' in Oxidation States, 'Meteor' in Meteorological Organization, 'Mus' in Musical Arts. Pushed positive, it writes 'organization', 'organ' and 'org' and spams them.

L27n1922.name: Inner split-term piece
L27n1922.description: Fires on an inner piece of a split anatomical or technical word ('ch' in paren|ch|yma, 'ider' in epi|der|mis, 'uter' in intra|uter|ine), and on 'in' in 'stay in shape' and 'series' in series motor. Pushed positive, it writes 'character' or 'characteristic' and spams it.

L27n2043.name: Capacity adjective before noun
L27n2043.description: Fires on a person-capacity adjective just before the noun it modifies: 'academic' in academic performance, 'genetic' in genetic makeup, 'human' in human rights, 'imaginative' in imaginative activity, 'true' in true identity, 'physical' in physical body. Pushed positive, it writes 'potential' and spams it.

L27n1019.name: Opening parenthesis
L27n1019.description: Fires on an opening '(' right after a noun, number or term, starting an aside, unit, acronym or citation: 'Prophet (', '15.6 °C (', '(IGF-1', '(PDD-NOS)', and '=(' in ALL=(ALL). Pushed positive, it writes single consonant letters ('b', 'd', 'p', 'r') and spams them.

L27n1613.name: Modifier before element noun
L27n1613.description: Goes negative on a modifier that opens a technical noun phrase and sits just before its head noun: 'retro' in retroviruses, 'DNA' in DNA sequences, 'cutting' in cutting chips, 'space' in space weather, 'fuse' and 'circuit' in genetic terms. Pushed negative, it writes 'element' or 'elements' and spams them.

L27n2217.name: Taxon or place fragment
L27n2217.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a Latin taxon, place name or technical term: 'ht' in Ikhtiyar, 'put' in Pseudomonas putida, 'apt' in Diaptomus, 'yle' in Xyleborus, 'sap' in sapodilla, 'Bhag' in Bhagabhadra. Pushed positive, it writes 'water', 'Water' or 'waters' and spams it.

L27n1459.name: Prefix or compound-part start
L27n1459.description: Fires on a word-initial prefix piece or the first half of a compound modifier: 're' in reorganized, reimagined and reestablished, 'co' in co-operative, 'self' in self-organise, 'mis' in misshapen, and the first halves of federally-, newly-, culturally- and socio- compounds. Pushed positive, it writes compound-suffix tokens ('-based', '-like', '-style', '-driven') and spams them.

L27n1282.name: 'in' in fixed idioms
L27n1282.description: Goes negative on the word opening a fixed idiom: 'in' in 'in mind', 'in place', 'in fact' and 'in full swing', and 'a' in 'with a view' or 'with a sharp eye'. Pushed negative, it writes 'view' or 'View' and spams it. The read and the write do not clearly match.

L27n1158.name: Product or term start
L27n1158.description: Fires on the first piece of a named product, software or subject term whose name continues: 'Digital' in Adobe Digital Editions, 'conc' in concordance, 'sc' in scoliosis, 'Sc' in Scissorhands, 'sa' in sauté. Pushed positive, it writes 'create', 'creation' or 'created' and spams them.

L27n1985.name: Word piece; writes match
L27n1985.description: Goes negative on an early piece of a multi-token word or name: 'And' in Andalusia, 'em' in placemats, 'cro' in crocodiles, 'mel' in melons, 'M' in INDEX/MATCH, 'on' in Borglum. Pushed negative, it writes 'match' or 'matches' and spams it.

L27n1381.name: Verb onset; writes reflexive
L27n1381.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split verb, mostly past participles or stems: 'spr' in sprouted, 'sh' in shut down, 'mar' in marinated, 'bur' in burdened, 'def' in defied, 'dec' in decimated. Pushed negative, it writes reflexive pronouns ('herself', 'myself', 'themselves') and spams them.

L27n546.name: Plural-noun onset
L27n546.description: Fires on the first piece of a split plural common noun, often an s, st, sl or pl onset: 'st' in staves and stolons, 's' in sponges, 'pl' in plagues, 'sl' in slippers, 'st' in stews, 'Di' in diets, 'l' in litters. Pushed positive, it writes plural nouns ('systems', 'arrays', 'lists', 'matrices', 'networks') and spams them.

L27n729.name: Split-word stem pieces
L27n729.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word is still to come: 'syll' in syllables, 'Pr' in Pruning, 'uk' in eukaryotes, 'bas' in basal. Pushes toward 'line' and 'function' tokens.

L27n2049.name: Split-word opening pieces
L27n2049.description: Goes positive on the opening piece of a split word, e.g. 'sh' in shelve, shore and shatter, 'hon' in honours, 'par' in parrot and Pariah, 'Wol' in Wolpertingers. Pushes toward 'form' tokens.

L27n507.name: Title and name middles
L27n507.description: Goes positive on a word inside a multi-word title or name just before its head word, e.g. 'Social' in Catholic Social Services, 'Living' in Survey of Living Conditions, 'de' in Bureau International de l'Heure. Pushes toward abstract nouns like 'Question' and 'Result'.

L27n763.name: Digit inside numbers
L27n763.description: Goes positive on a digit in the middle of a multi-digit number or date, e.g. '7' in 1752, '8' in 1584, '8' in Mar. 8, plus some word-fragment starts. Pushes toward '8' and 'eight'.

L27n1305.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n1305.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word fragment inside a name or compound, e.g. 'ng' in Miguel Ángel, 'arch' in archnemesis, 'ich' in Cowichan, 'omn' in omnichannel. Under push it writes JSON quote-and-comma tokens, while steering at -0.5 gives normal prose.

L27n1396.name: Commas in symptom lists
L27n1396.description: Goes positive on the comma that ends one item in a list of symptoms or conditions ('nose,' 'headaches,' 'nausea,'), and on onset fragments of symptom words like 'cl' in clenching and 'sn' in sneezing. Pushes toward commas and quote-comma tokens.

L27n1468.name: 'Power' after bloc adjectives
L27n1468.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before 'power(s)' in political or military text, e.g. 'Axis' in Axis powers, 'Allied' in Allied powers, and 'coalition', 'imperial', 'dominant'. Pushes hard toward 'power'.

L27n1110.name: Word before past participle
L27n1110.description: Goes strongly negative on the word right before a past participle or passive, e.g. 'be' in 'may be taken', 'heavily' in 'heavily armoured', 'specially' and 'poorly', 'un' in unpasteurized. Pushes toward participles like 'lost' and 'sent'.

L27n2268.name: Split-word starts (yes)
L27n2268.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'fl' in flaxseed and fluoroquinolones, 'conf' in confute, 'gl' in polyglots, 'And' in Andalusia. Writes affirmation words: 'yes', 'sure', 'indeed'.

L27n1348.name: 'Trans' word starts
L27n1348.description: Goes positive on the word before or at the start of a 'trans' word, e.g. 'reverse' in reverse transcriptase, 'transl' in translational, 'neurotrans' in neurotransmitters. Pushes toward 'trans'.

L27n1915.name: Modifier before 'design'
L27n1915.description: Goes strongly negative on the word right before 'design' in compounds, e.g. 'experimental', 'Industrial', 'Research', 'sound', 'production'. Pushes hard toward 'design'.

L27n1773.name: Word-initial 'c' pieces
L27n1773.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'c' or 'cr' opening piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'c' in clogged and cabs, 'cr' in crannog, 'cruc' in crucified. Pushes toward 'cross'.

L27n855.name: Name and term pieces
L27n855.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a multi-token name or technical term, e.g. 'Bur' in Burj Khalifa, 'ju' in juice, 'brid' in disulfide-bridged, 'Pid' in Pidgin. Pushes toward 'J'.

L27n473.name: 'Over-' excess prefix
L27n473.description: Goes strongly negative on 'over' as an excess prefix or phrase ('over-do', 'over-population', 'over-hype', 'Over time'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'good'.

L27n2079.name: Proper-name first pieces
L27n2079.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a multi-token proper name or place, e.g. 'Am' in Amherst and Amorite, 'Nem' in Nemadji, 'lem' in Charlemagne, 'Hum' in Humble. Pushes toward 'available'.

L27n1331.name: Word-initial 'p' pieces
L27n1331.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'p' piece, e.g. 'p' in patted, puzzles, puffling, pungent and productive. Under push it writes 'fun' and 'fuck'.

L27n2466.name: 'Sw' pieces, water writer
L27n2466.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'sw' start of a word, e.g. 'Sw' in swallowing and swelling, 'sw' in swamps and swimmers, and water-related starts like 'seaw' and 'drinking'. Pushes toward 'water'.

L27n411.name: Name and caps middles
L27n411.description: Goes positive on the middle piece of a name or ALL-CAPS phrase, e.g. 'Cape' in Cape Town, 'Rock' in Rockwall, 'IS' in an all-caps 'YOUR TEENAGER IS', 'house' in Greenhouse gas. Pushes toward person nouns like 'student' and 'customer'.

L27n209.name: Modifier before head noun
L27n209.description: Goes positive on an adjective, number or name word right before its head noun, e.g. 'Great' in Great Lakes, 'Seven' in Seven Sages, 'ripe' in ripe tomatoes, 'Better' in Better decisions. Pushes toward generic nouns like 'page', 'file', 'value'.

L27n2626.name: Stra/tra word starts
L27n2626.description: Goes positive on the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'tra' in Trauma, 'bre' in breasted, 'til' in tilting, 'Bal' in Balancing. Writes 'ay' pieces.

L27n1769.name: Capital P word opener
L27n1769.description: Fires on a bare capital 'P' (also Pl, Ep, St, Br, Dis) that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. P|ies, P|NAS, P|uffins, P|uzzles, P|isan; pushed negative it promotes 'difficulty'.

L27n1805.name: Mid-word hyphen-letter pieces
L27n1805.description: Fires on short non-final pieces that leave a word open, e.g. 'pend' in Har|pend|en, 'd' in sand|d|unes, and hyphen-letters like '-d' in flower-d|otted; pushed negative it promotes 'date'.

L27n917.name: Mid-phrase word pieces, commas
L27n917.description: Fires on mid-phrase tokens that leave a word or list unfinished: word pieces (emb|arks, Hymen|oph|yllaceae, chron|ology) and commas inside symptom or item lists; pushed positive it promotes 'function'.

L27n1716.name: Initial consonant word starts
L27n1716.description: Fires on the opening consonant or single letter of a capitalised name or word split into pieces (Pl|atanus, Fl|avius, B|ofors, l|abeled, br|ucei); pushed negative it promotes lone word-start letters (p, c, m, b, g) and garbled consonant strings.

L27n2287.name: Rare-name first pieces
L27n2287.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare name or foreign word split into tokens, mid-sentence (Hu|izinga, Ep|ilepsy, Sid|on, Kr|abi, Bod|rum, av|ocados); pushed positive it promotes 'easy'.

L27n1537.name: Split-word openers
L27n1537.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mostly consonant starts (Lips|chutz, contr|arious, st|earic, molt|sh|ed, Pr|iscus); pushed negative it promotes 'choice'.

L27n1656.name: Per- prefix opener
L27n1656.description: Fires on the 'per' or 'Per' token opening a word like peri|tonsillar, peri|natal, per|nicious, peri|toneal (also app, unp, par); pushed positive it promotes 'results'.

L27n1573.name: Word openers, 'there has'
L27n1573.description: Fires on word-opening fragments of nouns and names (de|odorized, T|isha, Hem|atoma, Can|ena, pur|ports, dise|ased) and on 'has' or 'have' after 'there' (there has been); pushed negative it promotes 'development'.

L27n949.name: Pro- word opener
L27n949.description: Fires on the 'pro' or 'Pro' token opening a split word (pro|phethood, pro|liferation, Pro|clamation, pro|dded, pro|videncejournal), plus 'Az' and 'Ap' openers; pushed positive it promotes 'test'.

L27n1936.name: Capital name openers
L27n1936.description: Fires on the capital opener of a proper name split into pieces (Car|ibbean, Ul|ster, Ram|ihantaniarivo, Rom|mel, Ros|alind, Wil|son); also 'cross' before 'flow'; pushed negative it promotes 'reference'.

L27n657.name: Consonant-vowel syllable pieces
L27n657.description: Fires on short consonant-vowel pieces inside a split foreign or rare word (cu|irass, ju|ice, di|uretic, we|vil, F|uru|hashi, Zer|we|kh); pushed negative it promotes single consonant letters (j, k, z, h) and produces junk.

L27n1337.name: Lone 'f' word opener
L27n1337.description: Fires on a lone 'f' that opens a split word (f|lossing, f|ussy, f|ashions, f|ide), and on 'Fr', 'Ne', 'eh' openers (Fr|anks, Ne|olithic); pushed positive it promotes 'success'.

L27n1288.name: Fixed-continuation tokens
L27n1288.description: Fires on a token where the next word is nearly fixed by context: 'yum' in sudo yum| install, 'amb' in Susilo B|amb|ang, 'a' in 'takes a| minute', 'Hello' in Hello| Tractor; pushed positive it promotes 'local'.

L27n1112.name: Token before main verb
L27n1112.description: Fires on the token just before a clause's main verb, mainly auxiliaries and adverbs ('has', 'is', 'hasn't', 'often', 'then' in 'circled low, then soared'); pushed positive it promotes verb forms like 'make'.

L27n253.name: Mid-word pieces
L27n253.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a word split into several tokens, usually mid-word (m|of|ait, Zu|ig|etsu, tr|ish|atorrey, spl|ints, Co|thi, d|ṛ|ś); pushed negative it promotes word-internal endings (itate, tent, ette).

L27n1617.name: Consonant-led word openers
L27n1617.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, mostly consonant-led (sur|ges, str|icken, char|ity, sp|ires, ac|urricular, Ac|quired, Unc|les); pushed positive it promotes 'cause'.

L27n1437.name: Name pieces, 'up close'
L27n1437.description: Fires on mid-name fragments (Dal|ma|u, sup|ran|ational, Gal|ap|agos, spr|outs) and on the particle 'up' before 'close' or 'to' (solar technology up close); pushed positive it promotes 'close'.

L27n785.name: Rare-name middle pieces
L27n785.description: Fires on a middle piece of a rare name split into several tokens (Abdu'l-B|ah|á, Hot|am|isligil, Alm|oh|ad, Dvur Kral|ove); pushed positive it promotes 'eight'.

L27n725.name: Sentence-final period
L27n725.description: Fires on the full stop that closes a sentence, mainly in answers and short factual prose (corrosion<.>, immediately<.>, Probably not<.>); pushed positive it promotes closing code tokens like ');'.

L27n2543.name: Ch- and p- openers
L27n2543.description: Fires on the 'Ch' opener of a word or name (Ch|aldeans, Ch|ugoku, Ch|acocente, Ch|aucer, Ch|ivalry) and on 'p' or 'P' starts after a hyphen or at a word start (self-p|ublished, bee-p|ollinated, P|atches); pushed negative it promotes 'technology'.
